40023178.author: पदार्थः
40023178.content: ते those, दूताः messengers, रामवाक्येन by Rama's command, चोदिताः urged, लघुविक्रमाः swift in action, प्रजग्मुः they went forth, मधुराम् to Mathura, शीघ्रम् quickly, चक्रुः they made, वासम् a stay, न not, च and, अध्वनि on the way.

40023178.author: Translation
40023178.content: Those messengers, urged by Rama's command and swift in their journey, quickly set forth for Mathura and did not make any halts on the way.

40023179.author: पदार्थः
40023179.content: ते they, तु indeed, त्रिभिः by three, अहोरात्रैः days and nights, सम्प्राप्य having reached, मधुरामथ then Mathura, शत्रुघ्नाय to Shatrughna, यथातत्त्वम् as it truly happened, आचख्युः they narrated, सर्वम् all, एव indeed, तत् that

40023179.author: Translation
40023179.content: Having reached Mathura in three days and nights, they truthfully narrated all the events to Shatrughna.

40023180.author: पदार्थः
40023180.content: लक्ष्मणस्य of Lakshmana, परित्यागम् the abandonment, प्रतिज्ञाम् the vow, राघवस्य of Rama, च and, पुत्रयोः of the two sons, अभिषेकम् the coronation, च and, पौरानुगमनम् the following by the citizens, तथा and also

40023180.author: Translation
40023180.content: They recounted Lakshmana's abandonment, Rama's vow, the coronation of his two sons, and the citizens' departure with him.

40023181.author: पदार्थः
40023181.content: कुशस्य for Kusha, नगरी city, रम्या beautiful, विन्ध्यपर्वतरोधसि on the slope of the Vindhya mountain, कुशावतीति as Kushavati, नाम्ना by name, सा that, कृता was established, रामेण by Rama, धीमता by the wise one, श्रावस्तीति as Shravasti, पुरी city, रम्या beautiful, श्राविता was assigned, च and, लवस्य for Lava, ह indeed

40023181.author: Translation
40023181.content: The wise Rama established a beautiful city named Kushavati on the Vindhya mountain slopes for Kusha, and the beautiful city of Shravasti was assigned to Lava.

40023182.author: पदार्थः
40023182.content: अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, विजनाम् deserted, कृत्वा having made, राघवः Rama, भरतः Bharata, तथा and also, स्वर्गस्य to heaven, गमनोद्योगम् the preparation for going, कृतवन्तौ they both made, महारथौ the two great warriors

40023182.author: Translation
40023182.content: Having rendered Ayodhya deserted, Rama and Bharata, the two great warriors, prepared for their journey to heaven.

40023183.author: पदार्थः
40023183.content: एवम् thus, सर्वम् all, निवेद्य having reported, आशु quickly, शत्रुघ्नाय to Shatrughna, महात्मने to the great-souled one, विरेमुः they stopped, ते those, ततः then, दूताः messengers, त्वर hasten!, राज O King!, इति thus, च and, अब्रुवन् they said

40023183.author: Translation
40023183.content: Having quickly reported all this to the great-souled Shatrughna, the messengers then stopped and urged him, "Hasten, O King!"

40023184.author: पदार्थः
40023184.content: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, घोरसङ्काशम् dreadful-looking, कुलक्षयम् destruction of the family, उपस्थितम् approaching, प्रकृतीः the subjects, तु indeed, सानीय having assembled, काञ्चनम् Kanchana, च and, पुरोधसम् the chief priest,

40023184.author: Translation
40023184.content: Having heard about the dreadful and imminent destruction of his lineage, Rama assembled his subjects and the chief priest Kanchana.

40023185.author: पदार्थः
40023185.content: तेषाम् to them, सर्वम् all, यथावृत्तम् as it happened, अब्रवीत् spoke, रघुनन्दनः Rama, आत्मनः of himself, च and, विपर्यासम् the reversal, भविष्यम् the future, भ्रातृभिः with his brothers, सह together,

40023185.author: Translation
40023185.content: Rama then recounted to them all that had transpired, including his own impending departure and the future of his brothers.

40023186.author: पदार्थः
40023186.content: ततः then, पुत्रद्वयम् the two sons, वीरः the heroic, सः he, अभ्यषिञ्चत् consecrated, नराधिपः the king, सुबाहुः Subahu, मधुराम् Mathura, लेभे obtained, शत्रुघाती Shatrughati, च and, वैदिशम् Vaidisha,

40023186.author: Translation
40023186.content: Then, the heroic King Rama consecrated the two sons (of Shatrughna), with Subahu receiving Mathura and Shatrughati receiving Vaidisha.

40023187.author: पदार्थः
40023187.content: द्विधा into two parts, कृत्वा having divided, तु indeed, ताम् that, सेनाम् army, माधुरीम् of Mathura, पुत्रयोः for the two sons, द्वयोः both, धनम् wealth, च and, युक्तम् appropriate, कृत्वा having provided, वै indeed, स्थापयामास established, पार्थिवः the king,

40023187.author: Translation
40023187.content: The king (Rama) then divided the Mathura army into two parts for both sons and provided them with appropriate wealth, thus establishing them.

40023188.author: पदार्थः
40023188.content: सुबाहुम् Subahu, मधुरायाम् in Mathura, च and, वैदेशे in Vaidisha, शत्रुघातिनम् Shatrughati, स्थाप्य having established, तदा then, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, रथेन by chariot, एकेन a single, राघवः Rama, ययौ went.

40023188.author: Translation
40023188.content: Having established Subahu in Mathura and Shatrughati in Vaidisha, Rama then returned to Ayodhya in a single chariot.

40023189.author: पदार्थः
40023189.content: सः he, ददर्श saw, महात्मानम् the great soul, ज्वलन्तम् इव shining like, पावकम् fire, सूक्ष्मक्षौमाम्बरधरम् wearing fine silken garments, मुनिभिः with sages, सार्धम् together, अक्षयैः immortal.

40023189.author: Translation
40023189.content: He saw the great-souled one, shining like fire, clad in fine silken garments, accompanied by immortal sages.

40023190.author: पदार्थः
40023190.content: सः he, अभिवाद्य having saluted, ततः then, रामम् Rama, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, प्रयतेन्द्रियः with controlled senses, उवाच spoke, वाक्यम् words, धर्मज्ञम् to the knower of Dharma, धर्मम् एव only Dharma, अनुचिन्तयन् contemplating.

40023190.author: Translation
40023190.content: Then, having saluted Rama, the knower of Dharma, he spoke with folded hands and controlled senses, contemplating only righteousness.

40023191.author: पदार्थः
40023191.content: कृत्वा having performed, अभिषेकम् the consecration, सुतयोः of the two sons, द्वयोः both, राघवनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, तव your, अनुगमने in following, राजन् O King, विद्धि know, माम् me, कृतनिश्चयम् resolute.

40023191.author: Translation
40023191.content: O delight of the Raghus, O King, know that I am resolute in following you, having performed the consecration of both my sons.

40023192.author: पदार्थः
40023192.content: न च and not, अन्यत् अपि anything else even, वक्तव्यम् to be said, अतः therefore, वीर O hero, न not, शासनम् a command, विलोक्यमानम् being regarded, इच्छामि I wish, मद्विधेन by one like me, विशेषतः especially.

40023192.author: Translation
40023192.content: Therefore, O hero, nothing else is to be said, and I do not wish this to be regarded as a command, especially by one like me.

40023193.author: पदार्थः
40023193.content: तस्य his, ताम् that, बुद्धिम् resolve, अकलीबाम् unwavering, विज्ञाय having understood, रघुनन्दनः the delight of the Raghus, बाढम् इति एव "So be it" thus only, शत्रुघ्नम् to Shatrughna, रामः Rama, वाक्यम् words, उवाच ह spoke indeed.

40023193.author: Translation
40023193.content: Having understood Shatrughna's unwavering resolve, Rama, the delight of the Raghus, simply said "So be it" to him.

40023194.author: पदार्थः
40023194.content: तस्य his, वाक्यस्य of speech, वाक्यान्ते at the end of the speech, वानराः monkeys, कामरूपिणः assuming any form at will, ऋक्षराक्षससङ्घाश्च and groups of bears and rakshasas, समापेतुर gathered, अनेकशः in large numbers.

40023194.author: Translation
40023194.content: At the conclusion of his speech, numerous monkeys capable of changing their forms at will, along with groups of bears and rakshasas, gathered in great numbers.

40023195.author: पदार्थः
40023195.content: सुग्रीवं Sugriva, ते they, पुरस्कृत्य having placed in front, सर्व all, एव indeed, समागताः gathered, तं that, रामं Rama, द्रष्टुमनसः with a mind to see, स्वर्गाया towards heaven, अभिमुखं facing, स्थितम् standing.

40023195.author: Translation
40023195.content: All of them gathered, making Sugriva their leader, with the intention of seeing Rama, who was standing facing towards heaven.

40023196.author: पदार्थः
40023196.content: देवपुत्राः sons of gods, ऋषिसुताः sons of sages, गन्धर्वाणां of Gandharvas, सुतास्तथा and sons, रामक्षयं Rama's departure, विदित्वा having known, ते they, सर्व all, एव indeed, समागताः gathered.

40023196.author: Translation
40023196.content: Having learned of Rama's impending departure, the sons of gods, sons of sages, and sons of Gandharvas all gathered there.

40023197.author: पदार्थः
40023197.content: ते they, रामम Rama, अभिवाद्य having saluted, ऊचुः said, सर्वे all, वानरराक्षसाः monkeys and rakshasas, तवानुगमने in following you, राजन् O King, सम्प्राप्ताः arrived, कृतनिश्चयाः having made a firm resolve.

40023197.author: Translation
40023197.content: All the monkeys and rakshasas, having saluted Rama, said, "O King, we have arrived here with a firm resolve to follow you."

40023198.author: पदार्थः
40023198.content: यदि if, राम O Rama, विनास्माभिः without us, गच्छेस्त्वं you go, पुरुषोत्तम O best among men, यमदण्डमिव like the staff of Yama, उद्यम्य having raised, त्वया by you, स्म indeed, विनिपातिताः struck down.

40023198.author: Translation
40023198.content: "O Rama, best among men, if you depart without us, it would be as if we were struck down by you, like by the raised staff of Yama."

40023199.author: पदार्थः
40023199.content: तैः by them, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha (Rama), बाढम् certainly, इति thus, अब्रवीत् said, स्मयन् smiling

40023199.author: Translation
40023199.content: Smiling, Rama, thus addressed by them, replied, "Certainly."

40023200.author: पदार्थः
40023200.content: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval (meanwhile), रामम् to Rama, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, अपि also, महाबलः the mighty one, प्रणम्य having bowed, विधिवत् properly, वीरम् to the hero, विज्ञापयितुम् to inform, उद्यतः ready (prepared)

40023200.author: Translation
40023200.content: Meanwhile, the mighty Sugriva also, having properly bowed to the hero Rama, prepared to make a submission.

40023201.author: पदार्थः
40023201.content: अभिषिच्य having consecrated, अङ्गदम् Angada, वीरम् the hero, आगतः come, अस्मि I am, नरेश्वर O lord of men, तव your, अनुगमने in following, राजन् O king, विद्धि know, माम् me, कृतनिश्चयम् resolved (having made a firm decision)

40023201.author: Translation
40023201.content: O lord of men, I have come after consecrating the heroic Angada; O king, know me to be resolute in following you.

40023202.author: पदार्थः
40023202.content: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनम् word (speech), श्रुत्वा having heard, रामः Rama, रमयताम् among those who delight, वरः the best, वानरेन्द्रम् to the king of monkeys, अथ then, उवाच spoke, मैत्रम् friendship, तस्य his (Sugriva's), अनुचिन्तयन् contemplating (reflecting upon)

40023202.author: Translation
40023202.content: Having heard his words, Rama, the best among those who delight, then spoke to the king of monkeys, reflecting upon their friendship.

40023203.author: पदार्थः
40023203.content: सखे O friend, शृणुष्व listen, सुग्रीव Sugriva, न not, त्वया by you, अहम् I, विनाकृतः separated from, गच्छेयम् would go, देवलोकम् to the world of gods, वा or, परमम् supreme, वा or, पदम् abode, महत् great

40023203.author: Translation
40023203.content: "O friend Sugriva, listen," said Rama, "I would not go to the world of gods or to any great supreme abode without you."

40023204.author: पदार्थः
40023204.content: बिभीषणम् to Vibhishana, अथ then, उवाच spoke, राक्षसेन्द्रम् to the king of Rakshasas, महायशाः the greatly renowned (Rama), यावत् as long as, प्रजाः people, धरिष्यन्ति will exist, तावत् so long, त्वं you, वै indeed, बिभीषण O Vibhishana, राक्षसेन्द्र O king of Rakshasas, महावीर्य O greatly valorous one, लङ्कास्थः residing in Lanka, त्वं you, धरिष्यसि will endure.

40023204.author: Translation
40023204.content: The greatly renowned Rama then spoke to Vibhishana, the king of Rakshasas, declaring that as long as people exist, Vibhishana, the greatly valorous king of Rakshasas residing in Lanka, would indeed endure and rule.

40023205.author: पदार्थः
40023205.content: यावत् as long as, च and, चन्द्रः the moon, च and, सूर्यः the sun, च and, यावत् as long as, तिष्ठति remains, मेदिनी the earth, यावत् as long as, च and, मत्कथा my story, लोके in the world, तावत् so long, राज्यं kingdom, तव your, अस्तु let it be, इह here.

40023205.author: Translation
40023205.content: Rama declared that Vibhishana's kingdom would endure as long as the moon and sun exist, as long as the earth remains, and as long as Rama's story is told in the world.

40023206.author: पदार्थः
40023206.content: शासितः instructed, त्वं you, सखित्वेन as a friend, कार्यं to be done, ते by you, मम my, शासनम् command, प्रजाः subjects, संरक्ष protect, धर्मेण righteously, न not, उत्तरं a reply, वक्तुम् to speak, अर्हसि you ought.

40023206.author: Translation
40023206.content: Rama instructed Vibhishana as a friend that he must obey Rama's command to protect his subjects righteously, and he should not offer any counter-argument.

40023207.author: पदार्थः
40023207.content: किञ्च and something, अन्यत् else, वक्तुम् to speak, इच्छामि I wish, राक्षसेन्द्र O king of Rakshasas, महामते O greatly intelligent one.

40023207.author: Translation
40023207.content: Rama then added that he wished to speak something else to Vibhishana, the greatly intelligent king of Rakshasas.

40023208.author: पदार्थः
40023208.content: आराधय worship, जगन्नाथम् the lord of the world, इक्ष्वाकुकुलदैवतम् the deity of the Ikshvaku lineage, आराधनीयम् to be worshipped, अनिशं constantly, सर्वैः by all, दैवैः gods, सवासवैः with Vasava (Indra).

40023208.author: Translation
40023208.content: Rama further advised Vibhishana to constantly worship the Lord of the World, who is the deity of the Ikshvaku lineage and is worshipped by all gods, including Indra.

40023209.author: पदार्थः
40023209.content: तथेति "So be it" thus, प्रतिजग्राह accepted, रामवाक्यं Rama's words, विभीषणः Vibhishana, राजा the king, राक्षसमुख्यानां of the chief Rakshasas, राघवाज्ञाम् Rama's command, अनुस्मरन् remembering.

40023209.author: Translation
40023209.content: King Vibhishana, remembering Rama's command, accepted Rama's words, saying "So be it."

40023210.author: पदार्थः
40023210.content: तम् him, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, काकुत्स्थो Rama, हनूमन्तम् to Hanuman, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, जीविते in life, कृतबुद्धिस्त्वं you who have made up your mind, मा do not, प्रतिज्ञां your vow, विलोपय violate.

40023210.author: Translation
40023210.content: Having thus spoken to Vibhishana, Rama then addressed Hanuman, saying, "You who have resolved to live, do not violate your vow."

40023211.author: पदार्थः
40023211.content: मत्कथाः my stories, प्रचरिष्यन्ति will spread, यावत् as long as, लोके in the world, हरीश्वर O chief of monkeys, तावत् so long, रमस्व enjoy, सुप्रीतो very pleased, मद्वाक्यम् my words, अनुपालयन् obeying.

40023211.author: Translation
40023211.content: O chief of monkeys, as long as my stories are current in the world, you shall remain very pleased, obeying my command.

40023212.author: पदार्थः
40023212.content: एवम् thus, उक्तस्तु having been spoken to, हनुमान् Hanuman, राघवेण by Rama, महात्मना by the great-souled one, वाक्यं words, विज्ञापयामास submitted, परं great, हर्षम् joy, अवाप्य having obtained, च and.

40023212.author: Translation
40023212.content: Having been thus addressed by the great-souled Rama, Hanuman, filled with supreme joy, submitted his reply.

40023213.author: पदार्थः
40023213.content: यावत् as long as, तव your, कथा story, लोके in the world, विचरिष्यति will spread, पावनी purifying, तावत् so long, स्थास्यामि I shall remain, मेदिन्यां on the earth, तवाज्ञाम् your command, अनुपालयन् obeying.

40023213.author: Translation
40023213.content: As long as your purifying story spreads throughout the world, I shall remain on earth, obeying your command.

40023214.author: पदार्थः
40023214.content: जाम्बवन्तं Jambavan, तथा thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, तु indeed, वृद्धं old, ब्रह्मसुतं son of Brahma, तथा and, मैन्दं Mainda, च and, द्विविदं Dvivida, च and, एव indeed, पञ्च five, जाम्बवता with Jambavan, सह together.

40023214.author: Translation
40023214.content: Having thus spoken to the aged Jambavan, the son of Brahma, and also to Mainda and Dvivida, making a total of five including Jambavan.

40023215.author: पदार्थः
40023215.content: तान् to them, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, काकुत्स्थः Rama, descendant of Kakutstha, सर्वान् all, तान् those, ऋक्षवानरान् bears and monkeys, उवाच said, बाढं certainly, गच्छध्वं go, मया with me, सार्धं together, यथेप्सितम् as desired.

40023215.author: Translation
40023215.content: Having thus spoken to all those bears and monkeys, Rama, the descendant of Kakutstha, told them, "Certainly, go with me as you desire.". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टोतरशततमः सर्गः ।। 108 ।। Thus ends the hundred and eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
